params.name: customerId
params.description: Specifies the source/client's id registered and wants to use the SMS APIs

params.name: destinationAddress
params.description: Specifies the mobile numbers on which message needs to be delivered

params.name: dltTemplateId
params.description: Specifies the template id received after dlt registration.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Specifies the entity id received after dlt registration.

params.name: filterBlacklistNumbers
params.description: Specifies the flag to enable/disable filtering of blacklisted numbers

params.name: message
params.description: Specifies the message which needs to be delivered

params.name: messageType
params.description: Specifies the type of message which needs to be sent.

params.name: metaMap
params.description: Specifies url Shortener params and all the additional parameters

params.name: priority
params.description: Specifies the flag for priority of the messages

params.name: sourceAddress
params.description: Specifies the shortcode/senderId through which message would be sent
